cost.measured_as: Profiler Hessian pass + 36 GPTQ solves per layer

rules.C2_PILOT_PROMISING: pooled E2(q2) <= -1 % vs q1 AND layer output (C vs B) improves in >= 1 of L8/L16 AND no layer regresses by > 0.5 % vs q1 AND correctness AND cost modest
rules.C2_REGRESSION: any layer output (C vs B) > +0.5 %, or unstable quantization (non-finite / dead-column change)
rules.C2_SURROGATE_ONLY: pooled E2 criterion met but layer-output criteria not
rules.note: screening rules, not significance tests; frozen before any q = 2 quality result
